Each plane sold on eBay AU at A$108-182 (typically A$120-135), so a pair is roughly A$240-270 gross if both are RTF and unused. Open the boxes at viewing if allowed and check for transmitter, battery and USB charger. Retail price not found (AU hobby shop pages did not show prices to the tool). Prices have drifted down: 2024 sales A$125-182, 2025-26 A$108-136. Small boxes, easy to post, but flip tied to condition and the 2 sales per month pace.
